answer: Locks are recorded in harbor, expire in shale, and prism lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 156 aliases hence needs 30 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3708 identities would post 4562 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
